training.permitted: Use initialization and development records of the two scored instruments only. The published reserved blocks and all contemporaneous proxy readings are unavailable for fitting.

forecast: For each instrument use the same time and value history known to the candidate and last-reading forecast. A frozen early slope from the Shippingport native run can initialize the candidate. Exponentially damp the latest available rate. Freeze the candidate implementation, fitted parameters and test schedule on a public Git commit before scoring either event. Do not refit, realign, clip errors, change horizons or omit difficult times after scoring.

shippingport.assessment: Retrospective re-use of both previously disclosed v0.17.0 reserved blocks. Earlier evaluations and their errors are public. The two blocks keep exactly the original 10 pressure and nine mean temperature test observations. This is a development comparison, separate from the external event.
shippingport.eligibility: For each held reading, use only strictly earlier initialization or development history of the same instrument. No reading in either reserved block can update either forecast. No source-flagged reading supplies input or score.

external.population: Anonymous Combustion Engineering commercial unit. Plant identity and date are unavailable. Event covers pre-power primary-system heatup.
external.units: Use absolute MPa = 0.101325 + psig*0.006894757293168, °C = (0.5*(hot°F+cold°F)-32)*5/9. The leg mean is a proxy for bulk coolant temperature. Report graphical extraction limits.
external.extraction: Observe all three curves at every whole hour with graphical support, on the original time axis. Do not include h0 or h24 where coverage is incomplete. No selection on magnitude, slope or model error. No PDF or graphic redistribution.
external.availability: History ends at the forecast origin, including the reading at that origin. A previous test reading may initialize a later forecast only after its clock time has passed. Every target is withheld for the full forecast horizon from both models. No external responses for fitting or model selection. Preserve every eligible origin; use the same inputs for the last-reading forecast. No plant-specific boundary or power schedule assumed.

scoring.primarySuccess: Strictly smaller aggregate RMSE for both pressure and coolant temperature on the existing Shippingport reserved set and independently for both signals on all primary (one-hour) C-E forecasts. Report these four conditions separately. Four-hour scores are an additional forecast-horizon sensitivity. No pooling across units or events. Publish unfavorable results.
scoring.sensitivity: Report the minimum and maximum RMSE improvement when any single external forecast pair is removed, to identify dependence on a single interval. This descriptive range is not a confidence interval. Samples overlap at 4 hours.
scoring.scope: Evaluates forecasts conditioned on available readings. Open-loop startup and ability to predict another complete unit from a cold initial state are separate claims.
